notes.title: Update: Ver. 1.2.0
notes.content:
Added RESTART button (shortcut)
* Holding down the RESTART button for about one second during a game will return the game to the beginning.
* For gamepads, the RESTART button assignment can be changed.




 Adjusted the balance of some sound effects
 Fixed a minor bug
